اَلزُّهَا [ez-zuhâ] (هُدَى [hudâ] vezninde) Zînet ve revnak ve nümâyişi hûb ve tâb-dâr nesnelere denir; ve minhu yukâlu: زُهَا الدُّنْيَا أَيْ زِينَتُهَا وَأَنْيَاقُهَا
اَلزُّهَاءُ [ez-zuhâ] (zânın zammı ve elifin meddiyle) Mikdâr manâsınadır; minhu kavluhum: زُهَاءُ مِائَةٍ أَيْ قَدْرُ مِائَةٍ
ضحی Kamus turkide ضحی maddesi. Sayfa:852

cebel_mihveri_ocr.mihveri: المعنى المحوري: انكشاف الشمس وانبساط الضوء انبساطًا شاملا بلا ساتر: كالضحوة وما بعدها بوصفهن. ومنه ليلة ضحياء: مُضيئة لا عي فيها/ مُقَمِرة» وقمر صخيان» وسراج صخيان: مضيء٠.‏ ومنه كذلك «الأضحى من الخيل: الأبيض والأشهب؛ (من حيث إن البياض شفافية وظهور تام كالانكشاف وكا يفعل الضوء).

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: أَضْحَى • (ʔaḍḥā) IV (non-past يُضْحِي (yuḍḥī), verbal noun إِضْحَاء (ʔiḍḥāʔ))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From ضَحْوَة (ḍaḥwa, “morning”), from the root ض ح و (ḍ ḥ w). Sense of “become” resembles other verbs of similar meaning derived from different times of day; compare أَصْبَحَ (ʔaṣbaḥa), بَاتَ (bāta), أَمْسَى (ʔamsā), all meaning "become."
g: to set out (to do something), to commence (doing something)

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From بَيْنَ (bayna, “between”) + لَيْلَة (layla, “night”) + و (w, “ and”) + ضُحَا (ḍuḥā, “forenoon”) + هَا (hā, “its”), Literally, “between one night and its [following] morning”.
s: بَيْنَ (bayna, “between”) + لَيْلَة (layla, “night”) + و (w, “ and”) + ضُحَا (ḍuḥā, “forenoon”) + هَا (hā, “its”)
Literally, “between one night and its [following] morning”
g: in a short period of time, overnight, suddenly
outer, exterior, or exposed, side or region

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
g: plural of ضَاحِيَة (ḍāḥiya, “outskirts of a city”)

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From root ض ح و (ḍ ḥ w), though often written as ضُحًى (ḍuḥan), as if deriving from ض ح ي (ḍ ḥ y). Compare زِنًى (zinan) for a reverse situation.

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: ضُحًى • (ḍuḥan) m or f (construct state ضُحَى (ḍuḥā))
g: ellipsis of صَلَاة الضُّحَى (ṣalā(t) aḍ-ḍuḥā, “morning or forenoon prayer”)
sacrifice, something ritually offered for consumption
